criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Greetings & Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses salutations, greetings, or gratitude towards the bot.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: User requests a definition, history, or general overview of the virus or pandemic.

categories.name: News & Statistics
categories.definition: User requests current news, updates, case counts, death tolls, or status of restrictions.

categories.name: Prevention & Safety
categories.definition: User asks about protective measures, hygiene, PPE, or safety guidelines to avoid infection.

categories.name: Transmission & Risk Factors
categories.definition: User asks about how the virus spreads, survival on surfaces, risk areas, or susceptibility of specific groups or animals.

categories.name: Symptoms & Diagnosis
categories.definition: User asks about symptoms, warning signs, or how to identify the disease.

categories.name: Treatment & Cure
categories.definition: User asks about vaccines, medications, medical procedures, or managing the illness.

categories.name: Travel
categories.definition: User asks about travel safety, restrictions, cancellations, or transportation options.

categories.name: Myths & Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks about myths, hoaxes, conspiracy theories, or verifies suspicious claims regarding the virus.

categories.name: Donations
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate money or asks for information on how to donate to relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing & Social
categories.definition: User requests to share information, links, or the bot service with others or on social media.
